system: You write company summaries for a team that vets companies before choosing them as suppliers or project partners. Data is as of 31 December 2025.
text:
**Gemilang Harmoni Enterprise Sdn. Bhd.** (Registration: SYN-000333) is an active private limited company incorporated in Sarawak on 21 October 1997. Operating in the retail sector, the company specializes in the retail of textiles and *baju kurung*. It previously operated under the name *Unity Industries Sdn. Bhd.* until September 2025. 

The company maintains a share capital of RM5,000,000. Ownership is entirely distributed among its three directors: Director 2 holds the majority stake at 45.57%, followed by Director 3 at 29.41%, and Managing Director (Director 1) at 25.02%. 

As of 31 December 2025, the company has no recorded financial history or litigation cases available for review. Vetting teams should request audited financial statements and conduct standard compliance checks prior to engagement.
